source_document_v1_0.citation: Längle, A. (1992). What Are We Looking for When We Search for Meaning? Ultimate Reality and Meaning, 15(4), 306–314. https://doi.org/10.3138/uram.15.4.306

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to be; to endure/uphold. (FM of World/Reality)
primary_domains.justification_quote: The following table: "Noetic content: 1. TRUE (reality)" and "Motivation: Will to be" and "Mode of experience: can"

sub_themes.justification_quote: Central area of stage of meaning: Ontology

sub_themes.concept: Orientation by the true, by what is and by what is experienced as reality.
sub_themes.justification_quote: Meaning is therefore always orientation by the true, by what is and by what is experienced as reality. Meaning is unconditionally realistic. The person living meaningfully will face and grasp the facts. He needs their ground to hold and support him, in order to act and receive effects.

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to feel value/life. (FM of Life/Value)
primary_domains.justification_quote: The following table: "Noetic content: 2. ATTRACTIVE (value)" and "Motivation: Will to value" and "Mode of experience: like"

sub_themes.justification_quote: Central area of stage of meaning: Axiology

sub_themes.concept: Desire for the attractive and the valuable (to give and to receive).
sub_themes.justification_quote: At the same time, search for meaning includes the desire for the attractive, the desire for dealing with the valuable which man wants to give as much as to receive.

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to be oneself; to be just. (FM of Self/Justice)
primary_domains.justification_quote: The following table: "Noetic content: 3. RIGHT (relations)" and "Motivation: Will to the right" and "Mode of experience: may"

sub_themes.justification_quote: Central area of stage of meaning: Ethics

sub_themes.concept: Need for relations, responsibility, and justification of existence.
sub_themes.justification_quote: Finally, the need for relations is alive in meaning, for relating to oneself (responsibility) as well as to others, which enables the justification of existence.

sub_themes.concept: Personal integrity (responsibility and faithfulness to oneself)
sub_themes.justification_quote: Throughout this process he is ever looking for possibilities to make decisions in such a way that his personal integrity (in the sense of responsibility and faithfulness to oneself) is preserved.

primary_domains.theme_name: The ability to do good; to be creative/meaning. (FM of Meaning/Future)
primary_domains.justification_quote: The following table: "Noetic content: 4. MEANING" and "Motivation: Will to act/Will to meaning" and "Mode of experience: should/want"

sub_themes.justification_quote: Central area of stage of meaning: Existence
Motivation: Will to act/Will to meaning

sub_themes.concept: Decision about the best possibility in a situation.
sub_themes.justification_quote: The existential question of meaning leads up to the decision about the best possibility in a situation, which might also stand as a definition for existential meaning.
